reviews.title: Horrible support and a severe downgrade for almost €30
reviews.text: I've been a Notion user since 2023. I paid non-stop for their service, despite all the hiccups the AI encountered more often than not. Then, they upgraded the overall plan from the simple addon I purchased (the AI tool for text editing) to Business, keeping the original cost which, due to my different currency, is a bit higher than the original $10. Unfortunately, in the past few months I noticed more and more downgrades due to the makeovers they introduced. Back in May, there was a severe issue that literally made the entire AI tool completely unusable, as it locked up the memory with usage and made the web page and Desktop app freeze or crash every 10-20 minutes. I contacted the support, I've granted access to my workspace three times, provided screenshots and videos, only for them to never fix it until much later. In the meantime, I continued to pay in full for a service I could barely use, and when I was offered a compensation, they gave me a total of €4 out of the €24 I paid for two months straight, unable to take advantage of what I was giving cash for. Now, it turns out that starting from December, the Business plan will cost me €29 per month. Considering the constant issues this program is having, this is literally overpriced and I will be forced to cancel after so long, having to look for an alternative. Their support may seem helpful in the beginning, until you realize they just disregard you, sometimes even ghost you despite your urgency, and essentially treat you like a bank account more than an actual person. I love Notion, but this is just too much to deal with. Seeing this company turning into yet another money grab for a poor service is honestly very sad. The mobile app also happened to be very useful and allowed me to continue working on my projects even while being away from my computer; now it's always bugged and the $24-€29 is not justified.
